authoritative_sources: user correction: Kakao Ops is now AI Ops

intent.summary: Correct the Academy's AI Ops identity and connect real work Episodes back into reusable lesson candidates.

requirements.text: AI Core registry uses AI Ops, not Kakao Ops, as current project identity.
AI Ops is the PC-wide AI employee runtime and KakaoTalk is its first app adapter.
AI Core has an executable Episode to Feedback to Lesson Candidate bridge reusing existing Self-Evolution.
Both implementation PRs pass their required CI before merge.

lesson_observations.sanitized_summary: AI Core still described the current PC-wide AI employee runtime as Kakao Ops after the project had become AI Ops.
lesson_observations.proposed_change: Bind project identity, repository, mission and platform classification to AI Ops; treat KakaoTalk as an app adapter rather than the product identity.
lesson_observations.prediction: New Academy sessions should stop framing AI Ops as a Kakao-only bot.

lesson_observations.sanitized_summary: The first AI Ops registry CI run failed because the child source observation time exceeded the registry snapshot time and a regression test still pinned the old project identity.
lesson_observations.proposed_change: Treat project-identity migrations as an atomic registry snapshot plus regression-test update and verify snapshot chronology before opening the PR.
lesson_observations.prediction: The next project-identity migration should pass registry chronology and identity regression checks on its first CI run.

lesson_observations.sanitized_summary: The Episode feedback feature extended the existing Self-Evolution and Evolution Bridge instead of creating a parallel learning engine.
lesson_observations.proposed_change: Prefer thin bridges into existing Academy/Evolution contracts before introducing a new framework.
lesson_observations.prediction: Future Academy improvements should create fewer overlapping ledgers or evaluators.
